title: Compare source snapshots
responsibility: Report sorted added, deleted and modified files by comparing snapshot values.

inputs.name: sourceChanges.before
inputs.description: Earlier map of paths to content hashes or link markers.

inputs.name: sourceChanges.after
inputs.description: Later map of paths to content hashes or link markers.

outputs.name: sourceChanges
outputs.description: Changes sorted by path across both maps; equal values are omitted.
